title: Practicum II by Prior Learning Assessment (PLA)
description: Third-year practicum challenge. Present evidence of significant prior learning and practice experience in the form of a portfolio which specifically demonstrates the learning objectives and outcomes required in CYC310/311.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of CYC 310A, CYC 310, CYC 311.
Students in the Bachelor of Child and Youth Care program must earn a minimum grade of C+ in all pre- or co-requisites.
Students with significant work and/or volunteer experience in Child and Youth Care may complete this practicum by Prior Learning Assessment.

items.text: Admission to an undergraduate program in the School of Child and Youth Care
